newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Montreal unit closing 3 branches.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Montreal unit closing 3 branches.

text.p: Harris Bank, a unit of Bank of Montreal, said it will close on December 31 three of the branches it acquired from Household Bank last June.
Two are in Glenview, Ill. and one is in Palatine, Ill.
Employees of the affected branches will be transferred to other nearby Harris locations.

After the closings, the bank will have more than 140 locations serving the Chicago area market. Harris opened a location on Chicago's far South Side in November and plans two more sites later in the month and another in January. A Cicero, Ill. branch will open in May.
